hero.heading: Let’s Connect
hero.description: Whether you’re reaching out with a question, collaboration, speaking invitation, creative opportunity, testimony, or simply a message from the heart — you are welcome here. I’d love to hear from you.

sidebar.heading: Let’s Connect
sidebar.description: Thank you for visiting The Rib Restored. This space was created to encourage restoration, discernment, healing, creativity, and spiritual understanding. Whether your message is personal, professional, ministry-related, or simply a greeting — feel free to reach out below.
